description: Ground truth for Ripple's OTel mock. Traffic comes from data/graph-snapshot.json. `propagation` is the fraction of a callee's failures that surface as failures of the caller's own requests (1 = hard, 0 = soft). Ripple never reads this file: it has to discover hard vs soft edges by running failure experiments against the mock, exactly as it does against the real OpenTelemetry Demo.
